rules: Every page at liveproxima.org, in either app, renders this header and footer with the same labels, order, destinations, tokens and behavior.
Links into the other app are root-relative on the same domain. Nothing opens a new tab except external giving and Candid links.
The Give menu needs the Fundraise Up loader on every page that shows it, so fundraiseUpForm items open checkout in place.
A site may append its own version label after the footer meta line. Nothing else is site-specific.
